summary: Nostalgia can edit an old situation until returning looks easier than remembering why you left.
body: Nostalgia can edit an old situation until returning looks easier than remembering why you left. When Neptune opposes the North Node, an old relationship, dream, identity, belief, or plan can become easier to idealize precisely because the unfinished alternative has not had time to collect the same memories. There may be something worth recovering from the past, but recover the value, not the missing context. Compare the memory with what happened before you rebuild a new decision around the version that feels best in retrospect.
